045import java.lang.System.Logger;
046import java.sql.JDBCType;
047import java.sql.SQLException;
048
049import javax.sql.RowSet;
050
051import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsModel;
052import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff;
053
054import static dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.ConvertType.findJavaTypeClass;
055import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsUtils.objectID;
056import static java.lang.System.Logger.Level.*;
057
058/**
059 * Row set column based only a RowSet and column.
060 * <p>
061 * TODO: SO FAR ONLY USED WITH/FROM GRID. Issue with getColumnObject undo/redo.
062 */
063//
064// TODO: SimpleRSC exceptions
065// During contruction both name/index are verified.
066// Any SQL exceptions beyond that are probably due to
067// a dropped connectsion, AFAICT.
068// Compare/consider what SSComponent does.
069//
070public class SimpleRSC implements RSC {
071  private final RowsModel rowsModel;
072  private final int index;
073  private final String name;
074  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
075
076  private SimpleRSC(RowsModel rowsModel, Integer index, String name) throws SQLException {
077    this.rowsModel = rowsModel;
078    RowSet rs = rowsModel.getRowSet();
079    this.index = index != null ? index : RowSetOps.getColumnIndex(rs, name);
080    this.name = name != null ? name : RowSetOps.getColumnName(rs, index);
081  }
082
083  SimpleRSC(RowsModel rowsModel, int index) throws SQLException {
084    this(rowsModel, index, null);
085  }
086
087  SimpleRSC(RowsModel rowsModel, String name) throws SQLException {
088    this(rowsModel, null, name);
089  }
090
091  /** {@inheritDoc} */
092  @Override
093  public final RowSet getRowSet() {
094    return rowsModel.getRowSet();
095  }
096
097  /** {@inheritDoc} */
098  @Override
099  public final RowsModel getRowsModel() {
100    return rowsModel;
101  }
102
103  /** {@inheritDoc} */
104  @Override
105  public int getColumnIndex() {
106    return index;
107  }
108
109  /** {@inheritDoc} */
110  @Override
111  public String getColumnName() {
112    return name;
113  }
114
115  /** {@inheritDoc} */
116  @Override
117  public JDBCType getColumnJDBCType() {
118    try {
119      return RowSetOps.getJDBCColumnType(getRowSet(), index);
120    } catch (SQLException ex) {
121      throw new SqlRuntimeException(ex);
122    }
123  }
124
125  /** {@inheritDoc} */
126  // TODO: SQLException better?
127  @Override
128  public String getColumnText() {
129    String value = "";
130
131    try {
132      if (getRowSet().getRow() != 0) {
133        value = RowSetOps.getColumnObjectText(this);
134        if (!getAllowNull() && (value == null)) {
135          value = "";
136        }
137      }
138    } catch (final SQLException ex) {
139      logger.log(ERROR, getColumnForLog() + " - SQL Exception.", ex);
140      throw new SqlRuntimeException(ex);
141    }
142
143    return value;
144  }
145
146  /** {@inheritDoc} */
147  // TODO: SQLException better?
148  @Override
149  public <T> T getColumnObject(Class<T> clazz) {
150    T value = null;
151
152    try {
153      if (getRowSet().getRow() != 0) {
154        value = clazz.cast(RowSetOps.getColumnObject(this, findJavaTypeClass(getColumnJDBCType())));
155      }
156    } catch (final SQLException ex) {
157      logger.log(ERROR, getColumnForLog() + " - SQL Exception.", ex);
158      throw new SqlRuntimeException(ex);
159    }
160
161    return value;
162  }
163
164  // @Override
165  // public Object getColumnObject() throws SQLException
166  // {
167  //    if (getColumnCount() == 0)
168  //        return null;
169  //
170  //    Object objectValue = fetchCurrentValue(this);
171  //    return convertObjectType(objectValue, getColumnJDBCType());
172  // }
173
174  // // TODO: getTypedObject
175  // @Override
176  // public <T> T getTypedObject() throws SQLException
177  // {
178  //    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Not supported yet."); // Generated from nbfs://nbhost/SystemFileSystem/Templates/Classes/Code/GeneratedMethodBody
179  // }
180
181  /** {@inheritDoc} */
182  @Override
183  public boolean getAllowNull() {
184    return RowSetOps.isNullable(getRowSet(), index).orElse(true);
185  }
186
187  /** {@inheritDoc} */
188  @Override
189  public String getColumnForLog() {
190    return "[" + name + "]";
191  }
192
193  // Following to avoid not used error
194  static {
195    if (Boolean.FALSE)
196      try {
197        new SimpleRSC(null, 0).getColumnCount();
198      } catch (SQLException ex) {
199      }
200  }
201
202  private int getColumnCount() {
203    try {
204      return getRowSet().getMetaData().getColumnCount();
205    } catch (final SQLException ex) {
206      logger.log(ERROR, getColumnForLog() + " - SQL Exception.", ex);
207      throw new SqlRuntimeException(ex);
208    }
209  }
210
211  /** {@inheritDoc} */
212  @Override
213  public String toString() {
214    return String.format("SimpleRSC{%s %s, [%s], %d}", objectID(getRowsModel()),
215                         objectID(getRowSet()), name, index);
216  }
217}
